In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all brain cell types can support HCMV gene expression and that the extent of virus gene expression is related to the degree of cellular differentiation.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
astrocytoma cells are fully permissive, glioblastoma cells are partially permissive, and astroglial cells are not permissive to HMCV infection.
HCMV is able to infect and replicate within all cell types of the brain, although some cell types support more extensive viral replication than others.
HCMV infection in the brain is not limited to any one cell type.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain endothelial cell is not the major target for HCMV infection in the central nervous system and that astrocytes are the primary targets.
the brain endothelium is not a barrier for HCV entry into the CNS.
